recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-angle environmental portrait of a central male figure in streetwear standing in front of a classic blue lowrider car and a graffiti-covered brick wall, accompanied by a dog in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the vertical axis, anchored by the car's horizontal mass.
The dog in the lower right foreground creates a diagonal depth line toward the subject.
The graffiti wall on the left provides a textured, high-contrast backdrop that balances the open sky on the right.
Low-angle perspective enhances the subject's stature against a dramatic, cloudy sky.
coreInvariants: High-contrast, gritty texture across all surfaces.
Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject.
Deep blue and desaturated grey color palette.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, full-body figure occupying the middle vertical third, scaled to appear tall and imposing.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright blue classic car spanning the lower-middle horizontal section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the car, then follows the dog in the foreground before sweeping left to the graffiti wall.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant features a dramatic, desaturated sky to provide breathing room against the dense textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and browns in the environment and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep metallic blue of the car and the subject's varsity jacket.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White highlights on the jacket sleeves, shoes, and graffiti outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with crushed blacks and bright highlights; saturation is selectively high on the blue elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant warm tones like bright red or yellow.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are integrated into the wall texture as graffiti.
Heavy 3D extrusion effect pointing toward the center.
Rough, weathered edges mimicking spray paint and brick texture.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped to follow the perspective of the receding brick wall.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary text uses a hand-drawn 'tag' style script to complement the blocky display type.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight and blocky structure.
For secondary text to match the urban aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photo of a man in a blue varsity jacket and beanie standing in front of a blue 1960s lowrider car. To the left is a tall brick wall in perspective. In the foreground, a grey pitbull sits on the asphalt. The lighting is dramatic with a cloudy, desaturated sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply extra-bold condensed block lettering to the brick wall using a 3D perspective warp. Add a secondary hand-written graffiti tag style text underneath. Apply a brick texture overlay to all text to make it look painted on.

verificationChecks: Text follows the wall's perspective lines.
Subject is positioned in front of the car and text.
Color palette remains cool and desaturated except for the blues.

adjustableVariables: Saturation level of the blue car
Amount of cloud detail in the sky
Breed of the dog in the foreground
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific brand logos on the car or clothing
postGenerationChecks: Is the text properly integrated into the wall texture?
Does the low-angle perspective feel consistent across all elements?
Is the blue color the primary visual pop against the grey background?
Is the dog's scale realistic relative to the car and subject?
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Environmental Portrait = (Low-Angle Wide Shot + Central Subject + Mechanical Anchor) * (Gritty Texture + Desaturated Palette) + (Integrated Perspective Typography)
